architecture.bots: deterministic queue, dedup, checkpoint, proof, retry, handoff and completion controls
architecture.scheduler: dependency-aware DAG waves with bounded parallelism
architecture.effect_lanes: maximum one effectful lane unless a stronger mission contract explicitly lowers risk and proves authority
architecture.completion: every required task must have terminal SUCCESS; FAILURE/CONSTRAINT cannot be relabeled complete

integrations.omega_one: load balancing, DAG allocation, failure isolation and champion/challenger telemetry
integrations.jarvis: independent semantic verification callback after result
integrations.bubbles_omega2: existing capability discovery, squad formation, proof graph and anti-proliferation controls

truth_boundary: This contract governs provider-neutral source/runtime orchestration. It does not prove native ChatGPT background workers, provider deployment, provider credentials, external authority or completed external effects.
